content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th pass; 5th pass for ST candidates and Naxal-affected families Age limit: 18 to 28 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Local Women 10 years, Government Employees Up to 36 years Other conditions: Must be a local resident of Dantewada district. Must meet specific physical standards (height, chest). Must be free from physical disabilities like knock-knee or flat-foot. Must be medically fit. Desirable: Heavy motor vehicle driving license (5 marks) NCC 'C' certificate (5 marks) NSS 'C' certificate (5 marks) Knowledge of local dialect (20 marks)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Dantewada Police Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates not residing in Dantewada district. Candidates declared medically unfit.

content_sections.heading: How Will Dantewada Police Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document Verification Physical Measurement Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks) Written Examination (50 marks) Interview (20 marks) Physical Efficiency Test includes long jump, high jump, shot put, 100m and 800m race. Written exam covers General Knowledge, Reasoning, Local Geography, Culture, and Arithmetic.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Dantewada Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Dantewada Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 128 vacancies for Bastar Fighter Constable.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Dantewada Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached to the notification PDF) and send it to Office of the Superintendent of Police, District Dantewada, Chhattisgarh, PIN-494449, by registered post or in-person, to reach by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Local Women 10 years, Government Employees Up to 36 years.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th pass from a school in Chhattisgarh/Madhya Pradesh. ST candidates and Naxal-affected families/relief camp residents are eligible with 5th pass.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a local resident of Dantewada district. Must meet specific physical standards (height, chest). Must be free from physical disabilities like knock-knee or flat-foot. Must be medically fit.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not residing in Dantewada district. Candidates declared medically unfit.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document Verification. Physical Measurement. Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks). Written Examination (50 marks).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dantewada.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Educational certificates; Local resident certificate; Caste certificate; NCC/NSS/Driving license certificates for bonus marks.
